'''2007 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 20–21 January 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2007 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2007 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' Garden of Earthly Delights, 7907 Bustleton Ave, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania<ref name="sf-13051-184166">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=184166#p184166 2007 MPC Weekend Jan 19-21 (Friday - Sunday) Info], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (6 December 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125232031/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=13051 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 20–21 January 2007
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Jason Robinette]]<ref name="sf-13051-184166" />
* '''Winner:''' —

== Schedule and prizes ==

The Players Committee announced the weekend of 19–21 January 2007 on 6 December 2006. All events were held at Garden of Earthly Delights in Philadelphia, with [[Jason Robinette]] as tournament director. The main event was for 32 players. Entry was $35 from 5 December to 14 January and $50 from 15 to 18 January, $5 of it covering location costs, and registration closed at midnight on Thursday 18 January. The first 30 preregistered players were guaranteed a seed in Saturday's event, and the seeding was done using the various polls.<ref name="sf-13051-184166" />

* Friday play-in: $15, [[Open]] format, four games; the top two won paid entry into Day 1.
* Saturday, Day 1: [[Open]] format, single elimination, 1:15 per game; the final four went on to Day 2.
* Sunday, Day 2: no cost, and players did not have to use their Day 1 decks. The top two received glass and an automatic bid to the [[2007 World Championship]], and the top four split the cash 50/30/10/10.
* Side events: a Saturday Open Qualifier and a Sunday Consolation Open Qualifier, each $10 and six games of constructed Swiss, with an automatic bid to the 2007 World Championship for the winner and a 60/40 cash split for the top two.<ref name="sf-13051-184166" />

[[Virtual Set 12]] was legal. Players who preregistered received four sets of full-colour printouts of Virtual Set 12, and everyone who entered Day 1 two sets.<ref name="sf-13051-184193">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=184193#p184193 2007 MPC Weekend Jan 19-21 (Friday - Sunday) Info], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (6 December 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125232031/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=13051 Internet Archive]</ref> On 19 December 2006 the Advocate posting the announcements donated $100 to first place, and the Players Committee matched it, bringing first place to about $700.<ref name="sf-13051-187313">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=187313#p187313 2007 MPC Weekend Jan 19-21 (Friday - Sunday) Info], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 December 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125232031/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=13051 Internet Archive]</ref> On 12 January 2007 the Advocate account announced that Brian Harris had donated his $35 entry fee, also matched by the Players Committee, to buy sleeves for the top eight players, who had to resleeve for round 3, and for the top four on Sunday.<ref name="sf-13051-191930">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=191930#p191930 2007 MPC Weekend Jan 19-21 (Friday - Sunday) Info], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 January 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125232031/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=13051 Internet Archive]</ref> On 6 January 2007 [[Aaron Kingery]], posting as Archmage, was the 4 seed.<ref name="sf-13459-190675">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=190675#p190675 Match Play Championship Smack Talk Thread], Aaron Kingery (Archmage), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (6 January 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125171839/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13459.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-13459-190811">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=190811#p190811 Match Play Championship Smack Talk Thread], Matt Sokol (MrPurple), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (6 January 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125171839/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13459.html Internet Archive]</ref>
